title: Putting It Together
goal: Combine age, date, and travel/tradition language in connected sentences.
grammar: Integration: tener for age + dates; cada + tiene

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: Combine statements about age and date in one exchange.
Talk about travel plans tied to a birthday.
Use a simple pattern to say that traditions differ between countries.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can combine statements about age and date in one exchange.
I can talk about travel plans tied to a birthday.
I can use a simple pattern to say that traditions differ between countries.
